text:
olivia: NA-east canary stopped by deploy-bot. Gate: vuln_scan flagged moderate CVE in dependency stream-parse v2.0.0 pulled by analytics-worker:1.9.0. Change window ~3h. Options? pin to 1.8.7, regional carveout, request hotfix, or rollback.

deploy-bot: GATE FAILED - vuln_transitive: CVE-2026-3141 (severity: medium) in stream-parse v2.0.0. Affected artifact: registry.redwood/python/analytics-worker:1.9.0. Actions: pin image to 1.8.7, request vendor patch, or regional carveout.

kevin: Release lead - leaning to narrow regional carveout + image pin to 1.8.7 for na-east canary only. Keeps global rollout moving while we verify exploitability. I'll prepare manifest PR.

security: Security: temporary carveout okay with strict conditions: cosign/SBOM attach within 24h or vendor patch; add telemetry guards and rollback criteria. Opened SEC-2026-0150.

legal: Legal: approve 24h exception if security confirms remediation plan and release notes include customer-facing blurb.

qa: QA will run smoke + perf in na-east after pin and expand error budget checks. If 5xx >0.8% or p99 up >220ms for two consecutive 5-min windows, we roll back.

ops: Ops: confirm regional routing for na-east and that cache shards unaffected. We'll hold at 5% traffic slice until QA signs off.

olivia: Rollback triggers: (1) user-facing 5xx >0.8% sustained 10m, (2) p99 degrade >220ms two consecutive 5m windows, (3) unexplained surge in downstream errors >3 services. Owner: kevin for first 12h. I'll add to PR and release notes.

kevin: Commands for audit (will include in PR):

```
# pin na-east canary to previous image
kubectl -n prod-na-east set image deployment/analytics-worker analytics-worker=registry.redwood/python/analytics-worker:1.8.7 --record
# patch release manifest
git checkout -b release/pin-naeast-1.8.7 && sed -i 's/analytics-worker:1.9.0/analytics-worker:1.8.7/' k8s/releases/canary-na-east.yaml && git commit -am "pin analytics-worker to 1.8.7 for na-east carveout"
```

security-bot: temporary-carveout-request APPROVED by @security with 24h remediation SLA. Logged SEC-2026-0150. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: action=region-override na-east proceed with pinned image after PR merge. Audit log created.

kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/4690  smoke running at 5% traffic. Will update if metrics cross rollback thresholds.

olivia: Thanks team. Legal please add the approved blurb to release notes; security will follow up on cosign/SBOM verification.

legal: Added release note: "na-east regional carveout (24h) due to transitive vuln CVE-2026-3141; image pinned to 1.8.7 pending vendor/cosign verification (SEC-2026-0150)." :page_with_curl:
